name: porkchops with sage and fruit
instructions:
Sautéed porkchops in a brown-butter + sage + white-wine pan sauce, with a fruit axis (apricots / figs / their jams) as the direction to develop.

=== PROCEDURE (CURRENT) ===

1. SAUTÉ / BROWN the porkchops in UNSALTED BUTTER.
2. KEEP COOKING COVERED until you get BROWNED BUTTER.
3. ADD THE SAGE right before the wine stage.
4. DEGLAZE WITH WHITE WINE and keep cooking covered until the porkchops are done.
notes:
=== SAGE — POWDERED LOST ITS FUNK; TRY FRESH NEXT ===

Powdered sage LOST ITS FLAVOR/FUNK in this dish — maybe due to the heat? Next time: FRESH SAGE. (It goes in right before the wine stage either way.)

=== WANT TO TRY — THE FRUIT AXIS ===

APRICOTS, FIGS, or the corresponding JAM/PRESERVE. Pork + sage + stone fruit/fig is the direction this recipe is named for; none of it tested yet. The base is EXCELLENT even without the fruit — the fruit axis is upside, not a missing piece.
